full_prompt_en: A square science-fiction image looks straight down a shadowed mechanical passage toward an immense circular opening filled with vivid red light. Concentric rings of dark metal surround the aperture, their segmented ribs and small rectangular fittings visible in the dimness. The lower edge of the opening meets a pale horizontal platform. A single tiny human silhouette stands exactly on the central axis, facing the red expanse. The figure is dwarfed by the round structure and leaves a faint narrow reflection on the illuminated floor. A few small pale marks hang in a vertical line high inside the red field. Near the foreground, broad floor panels and low steps create a sequence of dark red and brown horizontal bands leading to the figure. The passage walls fade into almost black corners, so the eye moves immediately toward the bright circle. Although the structure has intricate mechanical detail, the image is controlled by three large shapes: the dark enclosing square, the blazing round void and the short pale threshold. Red light spills onto the lowest edges of the rings and across the central walkway. Other surfaces remain in deep, warm shadow, with only subtle metallic texture and restrained highlights. Edges around the glowing circle are crisp, while details in the distant dark recede quickly. The frontal symmetry and strong scale difference make the figure feel exposed and very small. The whole composition has an austere, ceremonial tension, with one still presence framed by an immense unknown light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形科幻图像沿阴暗机械通道正望向一处充满鲜红光线的巨大圆形开口。深色金属同心环围住洞口，分节肋条和小型矩形配件在暗中可见。开口下缘接到一块浅色水平平台。一名极小的人形剪影恰立于中央轴线上，面向红色无垠空间。人物被圆形结构衬得很小，在受光地板上留下一道细弱倒影。红色域高处有几枚浅色小标记竖向排列。靠近前景，宽阔地板板块和低台阶形成一道道深红、褐色水平带，引向人物。通道墙壁隐入近黑角落，视线因此立刻转向亮圆。结构虽有繁复机械细节，图像仍由三大形体控制：深色包围方形、炽亮圆洞与短浅色门槛。红光溢到环形结构最下方边缘，也铺过中央走道。其他表面保留在深暖阴影里，只有细微金属肌理和克制亮点。发光圆形周围的边缘清楚，远处暗部细节迅速退去。正面对称与强烈尺度差让人物显得暴露且渺小。整幅构图有严峻、仪式般的张力，一个静止身影被巨大的未知光线框住。
style_prompt_en: The image has a controlled cinematic digital surface organized by severe geometric symmetry and a very limited palette. Saturated red occupies one large circular area, surrounded by near-black brown and charcoal masses. Concentric arcs and repeated panel lines give the dark surfaces mechanical rhythm without competing with the central color field. A narrow pale band at the base provides the brightest structural counterpoint. Light seems to emerge from the red interior, skimming nearby edges and leaving distant recesses almost unreadable. Crisp boundaries define major shapes, while small material details dissolve into shadow. Foreground horizontal bands draw the eye inward toward a small focal mark on the axis. Depth is strong despite the simple layout, created by nested rings, receding floor strips and rapid falloff into darkness. The mood is vast and still, with scale, color area and directional glow carrying more force than surface decoration.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有受控的电影感数字表面，以严整几何对称和极窄调色组织。饱和红占据一块巨大的圆形区域，外围是近黑褐色和炭黑团块。同心弧线与重复板缝赋予暗面机械节奏，却不与中央色域争夺注意。底部一道窄浅色带构成最亮的结构对位。光似乎从红色内部发出，擦过近处边缘，远处凹陷则几乎不可辨。主要形状由清楚界线限定，小型材质细节渐渐溶入阴影。前景水平色带把视线引向轴线上的极小焦点。尽管布局简洁，嵌套环形、后退的地板条和迅速陷入黑暗的光线仍建立很强纵深。情绪宽大而静止，尺度、色彩面积和定向光比表面装饰更有力量。
theme_en: A lone dark figure stands before a huge circular red opening at the end of a shadowed mechanical passage
theme_zh: 一名独自的深色人影站在阴暗机械通道尽头的巨大红色圆形开口前
name: 2001: A Space Odyssey
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
